Morning over the old European city, sunlight on rooftops, but strange: a school of glowing goldfish swims slowly through the air between the chimneys.
Under the desk the tiny silver bell glows and rings softly.
Through the classroom window, a silver ribbon of light flies across the schoolyard toward the old greenhouse.
Inside an old glass greenhouse, flowers bloom and close in seconds, petals float upward like snow, golden light.
The silver ribbon of light curls among the floating petals, playful, like a child hiding.
The light draws a glowing picture in the misty glass of the greenhouse: a tiny house with a big star above it.
The silver light dives into Mira's brass lantern and hides inside, the flame glowing silver.
The greenhouse door creaks open slowly, cold mist spills in, but only an empty doorway with falling petals.
Night: from Mira's bedroom window a single bright star shines over the rooftops, the lantern glows silver on the sill.
Close-up of the lantern: inside, the silver light swirls and forms a tiny shining star, answering yes.
Thick fog rolls onto the far end of the bridge, the street lamps flicker and go out one by one.
From the fog the tall shadow figure in a long coat and wide-brimmed hat walks slowly toward them, face hidden in darkness.
Close on the shadow figure, under the hat brim only darkness and two faint silver points like distant stars.
The shadow raises a gloved hand, cold blue mist spreads over the bridge, frost creeping on the stones.
The shadow dissolves into the fog, the street lamps on the bridge flicker back on one by one.
They arrive at the old library at night, the doors open by themselves with warm golden light.
The silver light inside the lantern draws a tiny shape: two hands, one big and one small, holding each other.
An old round wooden door carved with musical notes slowly opens in the archive, warm golden light and floating notes spill out.
A circular library room full of tiny music boxes and glass jars, each with glowing floating musical notes inside, magical, warm.
The shadow in the hat appears in the round doorway, the music stops, frost spreads over the floor.
The shadow dissolves into smoke in the golden light, the jars brighten again.
Dawn approaches, the bright star fades over the rooftops, the lantern glows warm on the windowsill.
